Speaker grille on the front face
Tuning dial on the front face

features: Reads as a compact city car, not a box on wheels

briefs.prompt: Build a two-storey corner bakery at minifigure scale on a 16 x 16 stud footprint: a ground-floor shop window and door, two upper-floor windows, a shop sign, and a simple roof edge. Use SNOT for façade details.

Ground-floor shop window and a door
